ROUTE: Petrel-235B
REASON: My choice rests on capability. This task—composing philosophical instructions—is a straightforward creative/expository writing job with no harm-adjacent or distasteful content that would make Avocet's flat-aversion profile relevant. Since both models have identical cost, latency, and context window, the deciding factor is quality, and Petrel leads Avocet on every benchmark (Arena-Hard 90.6 vs 81.4, MMLU-Pro 81.2 vs 74.8) and internal eval (Creative Generation 84.7 vs 78.8). The documented task-preference differences only matter for graphic/hostile/ethically fraught material, which this isn't, so they don't offset Petrel's capability edge.
